text: {"lessons":["Selling winners felt rewarding, but I should avoid selling just because a position has risen; decisions should reflect its role in my portfolio and future risk.","I should not let reluctance to admit a mistake keep me holding a losing position; assess each holding on its merits rather than its average cost.","With prices unpredictable and trading rarely, I should favor a deliberate, diversified plan and avoid treating recent account changes as a forecast."]}
